subject: Request: credit and trial extension after spike-induced latency incident
messages:
From: John Sellers <jsellers@brightretail.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: BrightRetail Support <support@brightretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Production latency spike — urgent credit request

Hi Dylan,

We experienced a significant latency spike on Feb 10 between 06:22 and 08:45 PST that caused a backlog in our order ingestion pipeline. Several order batches retried and a small percentage failed entirely; this impacted checkout flows on our site and triggered manual reconciliations.

We've attached a CSV of the error timestamps and sample request IDs. We need two things:
- Confirmation of what happened and when the service returned to nominal
- A formal statement on the expected remediation (what prevented recurrence)

Given the customer impact, the procurement team has asked for a compensation proposal (credits or trial extension) while we finish our internal RCA. Please escalate.

Thanks,
John Sellers
Head of Platform Reliability
BrightRetail

Attachment: brightretail-order-errors-logs.csv
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: John Sellers <jsellers@brightretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — urgent credit request

John —

I’m really sorry for the disruption this morning. Thank you for sending the logs; we’ve pulled the traces and initiated a high-priority postmortem. Initial telemetry shows a sudden model routing surge that created short-lived queueing on one Dedicated pool while autoscaling kicked in.

Next steps: I’ve looped in Marissa to coordinate a commercial response and Grace on billing to start a provisional credit evaluation. We’ll share a concrete remediation summary and a credit proposal by end of day.

In the meantime, can you confirm the invoice period you’d like the credit applied against (Feb invoice or March)? Also, do you prefer a one-time goodwill credit or a trial extension on Redwood Optimize/Observe?

Again, apologies — we’ll make this right.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Production latency spike — suggested goodwill credit

Folks —

Context: BrightRetail is a mid-market strategic customer (annual committed spend ~ $350k). They hit a meaningful production regression that affected revenue. My suggestion for a fast, customer-forward response:
- Offer a one-time credit equal to 20% of Feb committed spend (~$12,000) OR an equivalent 60-day trial of Redwood Optimize and additional 30 days of usage credits to offset risk.
- Include a short SLA concession language in the credit note (no change to contract) and require a postmortem call with our SREs within 5 business days.

This is borderline for our standard playbook but the account is strategic; I recommend we expedite approval. I’ve attached their Feb invoice for reference.

If Grace can confirm billing constraints and Rishi can sign off on the spend, I’ll get the customer-facing note ready.

— Marissa
Senior Account Manager
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:55:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Production latency spike — suggested goodwill credit

Thanks for the context. Billing notes: we can approve a goodwill credit, but we should stay within our standard risk guardrails. Suggested offer:

- $8,000 one-time credit applied to the Feb invoice + a 30-day trial extension on Redwood Observe (to help them validate stability)
- Require acceptance via an email confirmation (we can issue a credit note after their confirmation)

I’ve attached the credit-approval-form.pdf — if legal wants any special language we’ll need to loop them, but this is fine under existing T&Cs.

If Sales prefers the larger $12k figure for retention reasons, I’ll need a quick manager sign-off (Rishi) to reallocate.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Billing & Revenue Ops
Attachment: credit-approval-form.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — suggested goodwill credit

Approve the $12k as a one-time goodwill credit for BrightRetail. Rationale: strategic account with expansion runway; retaining trust is higher value than the cost. Please proceed with the credit note and a postmortem call.

Marissa, coordinate the customer-facing language; include a brief summary of the remediation plan and offer a 60-minute follow-up with our SREs. Grace, you can bill the $12k to the discretionary credits pool under manager-approved exceptions (mark code BR-EXC-02).

Thanks — Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: John Sellers <jsellers@brightretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 17:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — urgent credit request

John —

Thanks again for your patience. Per our internal review and exec approval, Redwood will issue a one-time credit of $12,000 applied to your Feb invoice and a complimentary 60-day trial of Redwood Observe. We’re attaching the credit note and a short postmortem summary.

Action items:
- I’ve scheduled a 60-minute postmortem with our SREs for Wed Feb 18 at 10:00 PST (invite sent).
- Grace will issue the credit note and apply it to the Feb invoice; please reply to this thread to confirm acceptance.
- We’ll share the remediation plan and follow-up work items during the call.

Attached: credit-approval-form.pdf, postmortem-summary-BR-7421.pdf

We appreciate the partnership and want to ensure this does not happen again.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: credit-approval-form.pdf, postmortem-summary-BR-7421.pdf
